why: The same shape collapse with the citations LEFT IN PLACE, so the derived_from checks cannot catch it: criterion.Mission.retired-with-residuals.v1 is given criterion.Mission.retired.v1's body with the ids rewritten. The two edges out of Mission:active and Mission:parked then have effective guards nothing executable can tell apart, and phase-content-gaps.json does not declare either pair. This is the predicate FI-11 actually asserts. Mission was chosen over Goal deliberately: Goal's two edge guards already differ structurally -- endorsed->parked carries a transition_basis conjunct that endorsed->achieved does not -- so cloning the criterion there does NOT collide the edges, and the first version of this fixture leaked for exactly that reason. A fixture that does not reach the check it names proves nothing.
expect_failure_contains: sibling guards share a shape that phase-content-gaps.json does not declare
